summary.text: Cherri Rogers is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Eric Davanzo.
A registered nurse by career, she also ran for this seat in 2024, and in a Ballotpedia survey she named union jobs, health care costs and public school funding as her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Cherri Rogers earned a high school diploma from Hempfield High School, a bachelor's degree from Strayer University, a graduate degree from Capella University and a Doctor of Education from the University of Pittsburgh in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a registered nurse, and in her survey response she described a 30-year career as a nurse and member of the Pittsburgh Federation of Teachers and said she is a school nurse.
Rogers was the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House District 58 in 2024, when incumbent Eric Davanzo defeated her in the general election, 69.1 percent to 30.8 percent.

In the 2026 survey, Rogers said she grew up in a United Steelworkers household and listed her key messages as supporting organized labor and union jobs, lowering health care and prescription drug costs, and fully funding public schools while ending private school voucher programs.
